violated_contract: Hermetic app tests and the mobile-session doctor must not send traffic to a non-loopback API. app/test.sh skipped writing .dev.env when generated files already existed, so a leftover remote API_BASE_URL (or OMI_APP_PROFILE other than local_dev) silently survived.
canonical_prevention: Always refuse a non-empty non-loopback API_BASE_URL in app/.dev.env and a flavor/profile pairing other than dev + local_dev. Do not rewrite the file. Guard at app/scripts/check_hermetic_test_env.sh (called from app/test.sh even when generated files exist) and at mobile_doctor app-dev-env / app-pairing checks.
